title: Measure complete radio operation timelines
description:
Measure cold/warm retune, reset/calibration, BUSY, CAD, acquisition, RX/TX turnaround, IRQ and completion/error paths on the actual integrated driver. Reuse existing async/CAD and DIO1 diagnostic work; project-LICHEN-worker6-aglf supplies the existing modem-ownership fix rather than a duplicate implementation.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching authority.10/rf.03 approvals for this exact session before ports or RF. Use the resolved build inventory rather than a presumed toolchain version. Existing closed issues are code provenance, not measurement proof; denied/mismatched clearance leaves execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Correlated SPI/BUSY/IRQ/RF traces and independent clock references establish distributions, maximum observed latency, timeout behavior and missed deadlines. Record actual poll or synchronous-wrapper behavior. No universal 100 us retune, async-name guarantee or helper-only success is accepted as operation-fit evidence.
